title: Funds management: Establishing and registering a fund
subject: This guide provides guidance on the requirements for establishing and registering a managed investment scheme, registering as an Australian passport fund, and establishing and registering a corporate collective investment vehicle (CCIV) and its sub-funds.
background: The guide is issued under the Corporations Act 2001 and related legislation. It is intended for responsible entities of registered managed investment schemes, Australian passport fund operators, corporate directors of retail CCIVs, and their advisers. It explains ASIC's requirements and processes for registration applications.
ruling: ASIC outlines the application process for registering a managed investment scheme, including the role of the responsible entity and required application contents. For CCIVs, ASIC details the registration requirements for the vehicle and its initial sub-funds, as well as the process for registering further sub-funds. The guide also covers how ASIC assesses applications, including the criteria for registration and the information that must be provided. ASIC states that it will assess applications based on the legislative requirements and may request additional information. The guide also addresses the registration process for Australian passport funds under the Australian Passport Rules.
legislation_referenced: Australian Securities and Investments Commission Act 2001 (Cth)
